messages:
Claire: Quick heads-up — POC kickoff with Northbridge Health tomorrow 10am PT. Their infosec ask: SSO (SAML), SCIM user/group provisioning, strict RBAC role mapping, and domain controls (only *.northbridge.com). They've attached a security questionnaire link. Can we confirm what we can enable for the POC and any enterprise blockers?
Aisha: We support SAML IdPs (Okta, Azure AD, Ping). Enforced SSO is possible. Note: on Hosted we can enforce org-level SSO; for Dedicated/Private it's default. Need to confirm whether they want Hosted eval or Dedicated trial.
Claire: They're leaning hosted to start but require enforced SSO and SCIM so users can't create local accounts. Is that doable without Dedicated?
Aisha: Yes — hosted orgs can have SSO enforced (no local passwords) if we enable the enterprise feature flag. For production-grade enforcement and guaranteed isolation we recommend Dedicated, but for a POC hosted with the flag is fine.
Raj: Security checklist: we need their IdP metadata (entityID, x509 cert, SSO URL), and SCIM base URL + token for provisioning. We require TLS 1.2+, SCIM over HTTPS. Audit logs available for the POC (90d retention on hosted). If they need longer retention or HSM-backed keys -> Dedicated/Private.
Claire: SCIM specifics — do we do groups and group->role mapping? How often do we sync? Any rate limits?
Aisha: SCIM v2 supported for users + groups. Delta/patch provisioning supported. Sync cadence: delta polls every 5 minutes; full sync nightly. Rate limits: default 600 req/min on Hosted; Dedicated can raise on request. Supported attributes: userName(email), displayName, title, groups.
Ben (Solutions): For RBAC we map SCIM groups or SAML group attributes to three built-in roles: admin, developer, viewer. We can also support custom role sets on Dedicated/Private. Recommend mapping their Okta groups to our roles for the POC.
Claire: They also want domain controls — prevent invites/creation of non-@northbridge.com accounts. Is that in scope?
Aisha: Yes — org allowlist supports domain restriction (single or wildcard like *.northbridge.com). Works with SAML enforced.
Raj: A few security Qs from the questionnaire: do we provide SP metadata for SAML? Can we expose our SAML cert rotation schedule? What about SCIM token lifecycle?
Ben (Solutions): We can provide SP metadata: https://redwood.example.com/saml/sp/meta.xml (placeholder). Cert rotation: quarterly by default, we can share cert thumbprints. SCIM tokens are tenant-scoped, revokable, and we log usage in audit events.
DevOpsBot: Code snippet for quick SCIM provisioning test (put this in the POC runbook):
```bash
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <SCIM_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.example.com/scim/v2/Users \
  -d '{"userName":"test@northbridge.com","displayName":"Test User","emails":[{"value":"test@northbridge.com"}]}'
```
Claire: Perfect. For pricing/ops: can we offer a hosted 30-day eval with enterprise flags (SSO enforced + SCIM) at no charge? They may request Dedicated performance guarantees if throughput > 200rps.
Ben (Solutions): We usually offer a 30-day hosted eval with enterprise features enabled up to a soft cap (e.g., 2k monthly tokens). For Dedicated trials we need legal + infra lead sign-off; we can offer a temporary 30% trial discount if they commit to a paid Dedicated within 60 days. Private requires SOW and longer lead time.
Claire: I'll ask them to confirm hosted vs Dedicated and collect IdP metadata + SCIM admin token. Also forwarding the security questionnaire to Raj.
Raj: Got it. I'll start filling answers for SAML/SCIM and note audit/log retention options. If they require FedRAMP or special encryption patterns, escalate to Compliance.
Claire: Can someone put together a 1-page POC checklist I can send to the customer? Items: IdP metadata, SCIM admin token, test users/groups, expected traffic profile, list of admins, acceptance criteria (SSO enforced, group->role mapping validated, SCIM provisioning works).
Ben (Solutions): I'll draft the checklist and include the SP metadata URL + the curl sample. ETA 2 hours.
Aisha: I'll add the SCIM attribute map and rate limit notes to the runbook.
Claire: Thanks team — I'll sync after the customer provides the metadata. :thumbsup:
thread_summary: POC coordination for Northbridge Health: SAML SSO enforcement, SCIM provisioning, RBAC mapping, domain allowlist, audit/log retention, POC pricing and trial options. Tasks: collect IdP metadata and SCIM token, prepare POC checklist and runbook, security questionnaire review.
